examples.application: Reader-directed evaluation instructions use plain Punjabi verb forms such as قیمت کڈھو and رکھو.
Use ترتیب وار in original UI/support for the ordered worked steps, without claiming it establishes a technical term.
Use Punjabi plural agreement for expressions, examples and values.
Translate substitution as putting the given number متغیر دی بجائے, keeping the Punjabi relational phrase.
Use چیتے رکھو only in separately original base/exponent support, never as an inserted source sentence.
Mark source wording and image-summary mismatches as claims that need separate explanation.
Use کیوں جے for reason-giving in original clarification of the supplied-answer interpretation.
Open with a natural Punjabi transition from the preceding worked examples into evaluation.
